primary: Unweighted accuracy under the frozen480-question mixture, both correct/all requests and correct/completed. Refusal/truncation/other status counts stay explicit.

original_mix_comparator.target: Pilot03 planned recipe×lakara×voice cell weights, before outcome-independent exclusions; current policy08 supply used throughout.
original_mix_comparator.all_request_estimator: sum(w*correct)/sum(w), where correct=0 for any non-completion.
original_mix_comparator.completion_conditioned_estimator: sum(w*correct)/sum(w*completed); completion is not silently assumed independent of cell.
original_mix_comparator.interpretation: Fixed input reweighting measures the original grammar mixture on this fresh development panel; it is not a new independent sample or a restoration of excluded lexical families.

uncertainty.cluster_unit: Root family;240 clusters, exactly2 questions in different lakaras per cluster.
uncertainty.sandwich_se: For ratio p=sum(a)/sum(b), use sqrt[G/(G-1)*sum_f(sum_i_in_f(a_i-p*b_i))^2]/sum(b). All-request: a=w*correct,b=w; completed: a=w*correct,b=w*completed. w=1 for primary.
uncertainty.bootstrap: Seeded resampling of240 whole families with replacement,10000replicates; keep each original per-question weight fixed, recompute ratio, report percentile95% interval and bootstrap SE. Never re-estimate per-cell weights inside resamples, so sparse cells do not force discarding draws.
uncertainty.limits: Conditional on frozen availability/stratification and selected family allocation; development adaptation and grammar audit uncertainty are not covered by sampling intervals. Sample480 cannot establish sub1pp release precision.

dependence_diagnostics: Complete-pair correctness contingency table and pair agreement for all240families; separate all-request and jointly-completed subsets.
Descriptive pair covariance and family-cluster SE versus iid SE, with caution that paired questions deliberately use different tenses and share a nonuniform grammar mixture.
no_new_hardness_selection: No question or family is removed based solely on model failure; source-supported new exclusions apply across all outcomes and are reported alongside raw results.
